notes.title: Zap Dem Rats Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Zap Dem Rats Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version S 1.05[/h2]

[h3]Change Log[/h3]

Includes changes from version S 1.04 

Replaced image and voice for menu tutorial

Added stepped skipping for tutorial. Players who select skip before or during keyboard tutorial will now be prompted with the menu tutorial. Players can click anywhere again to skip the menu tutorial.

Fixed issue which would sometimes cause Vote Today to go out of sequence.

Fixed shader on Vote Early... Vote Often... Arrows to remove diffuse around transparent image.

Corrected Nav Mesh and transitional linking in Capitol

notes.title: Zap Dem Rats Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Zap Dem Rats Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version S 1.01[/h2]

[h3]Change Log[/h3]

New hidden coins added to 2A

Added blockade on Pennsylvania in 2A to help direct players and prevent confusion.

Adapted some building mesh colliders that were preventing direct shots from hitting zombies in some areas.

Updated 2A, Vote Today, Media City, & Woke U maps to fill horizon background better.

New road signs above Pennsylvania Avenue to help direct players at transition locations.

Fixed depot sign - No success sound on load of 2a and replacement sign now displays correctly.

Navmesh updated with new boundary control in 2A

Mission 1 NPC doubling in Cheetas corrected.

Added objectives completed notification to 2A(To follow on remaining areas)

Removed Interdimensional Portal from Tommy's Garage in Vote Today - to much confusion for new players who stumble upon it.

Updated Keyboard control screen during intro and menu.

notes.title: Zap Dem Rats now available on Steam & Google Play!
notes.content:
[h1]Zap Dem Rats now availible on Steam & Google Play![/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42091393/70cebc9ef970d1edece414f93f87fab78888ff7f.png[/img]

Players can now help Mr. Prez triumphantly return to the Whitehouse on most PC & Android devices! Zap Dem Rats officially released on Steam, March 30th 2022, and on Android, March 31st 2022. 

In celebration of our Steam launch we are offering a 25% promotional discount to players who purchase Zap Dem Rats within a week of launch. Players can now battle against those nasty demi-hornets for the low price of $3.74 by taking advantage of our sale.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42091393/b19c8caebffcf68a81a6fb7893373437f5a0e73a.png[/img]

For less than the price of a fast food meal you can experience the excitement that Zap Dem Rats has to offer.

[h2]The voice of the people[/h2]
Have you ever had an idea for a game and thought "How cool would it be if..." Brucent gamers know exactly how you feel, which is why we dedicated Woke U to support user suggested content.

[h3]Welcome to Woke U![/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42091393/7c28df8b34cd7e4b72ac41b0dfc7cd1d1555ba90.png[/img]

 Check out the Woke U campus and think about ways to expose the stupidity of wokeness in our universities. Submit suggestions or ideas on our website www.ZapDemRats.com and if selected see your name in the game credits.

There is no time like today to fix the political landscape in America and return Mr. Prez to his home on the hill.
